blocks.content: In our previous courses, you learned the fundamentals of JavaScript. If these concepts below aren't familiar to you, we recommend taking our JavaScript Basics Course first:

items: Working with arrays, strings, and objects

blocks.content: However, if you are comfortable writing programs involving these topics, it's time to delve deeper into JavaScript. We'll do it with this course.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
